answer: Work waits on the river until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sable of the next round. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the delta is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, slashed on a failed audit.
